### Niagen Bioscience Expands HSA/FSA Payment Option for the Pharmaceutical-Grade Niagen™ At-Home Injection Kit through Niagen™ Plus


November 12, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/770776702/files/doc_news/Niagen-Bioscience-Expands-HSAFSA-Payment-Option-for-the-Pharmaceutical-Grade-Niagen-At-Home-Injection-Kit-through-Niagen-Plus-2026.pdf)


*Qualified customers may now purchase the Niagen* *™* *At-Home Injection Kit on*[www.niagenplus.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenplus.com&esheet=54640156&newsitemid=20261112603360&lan=en-US&anchor=www.niagenplus.com&index=1&md5=e4ccad4254af2ecc4a106ac78430d5f0) *using HSA/FSA funds with Truemed*


LOS ANGELES--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Niagen Bioscience, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenbioscience.com%2F&esheet=54640156&newsitemid=20261112603360&lan=en-US&anchor=Niagen+Bioscience%2C+Inc.&index=2&md5=a49deba286f6b211b1411f5c8716268e) (NASDAQ: NAGE), the global authority on NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) with a focus on the science of healthy aging, today announced that it has partnered with Truemed to provide qualified customers the option to purchase the Niagen™ At-Home Injection Kit using Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) funds, now available through its[Niagen™ Plus](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenplus.com%2F&esheet=54640156&newsitemid=20261112603360&lan=en-US&anchor=Niagen%E2%84%A2+Plus&index=3&md5=4d260ef09e8769042c7f72b1ebce5104) telehealth platform. Qualified customers may use HSA/FSA funds to purchase the Niagen At-Home Injection Kit by selecting the Truemed (Pay with HSA/FSA) option at checkout.


Qualified Customers may now purchase the Niagen™ At-Home Injection Kit on www.niagenplus.com using HSA/FSA funds with Truemed


Rob Fried, CEO of Niagen Bioscience, remarked, “NAD+ injections are everywhere, but none are backed by published clinical research. We did the research on Niagen injections, and HSA/FSA eligibility puts our science-first approach within reach of more people.”


Pharmaceutical-grade injectable Niagen® (patented nicotinamide riboside chloride, or NRCl), the most efficient, well-researched, and high-quality NAD+ precursor brand available, is now accessible in ready-to-inject liquid and reconstituted powder formats, with qualified customers saving an average of 30% using HSA/FSA funds through Truemed.


The Company[recently announced](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.niagenbioscience.com%2Fnews%2Fnews-details%2F2026%2FNiagen-Bioscience-Launches-Niagen-Plus-Liquid-At-Home-Injections-to-Support-Telehealth-Expansion%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54640156&newsitemid=20261112603360&lan=en-US&anchor=recently+announced&index=4&md5=12aca179225cd6cce99340716e47426a) the publication of two open-label clinical trials on medRxiv evaluating subcutaneous (sub-q) and intramuscular (IM) Niagen injections. While NAD+ injections are increasingly popular, no published clinical trials have evaluated sub-q or IM NAD+ injections. In these trials, injectable Niagen was well tolerated, including over 90 days of at-home use, and exploratory, self-reported outcomes were associated with reduced fatigue and improved sleep and skin appearance. These findings require confirmation in larger, placebo-controlled studies ([Nkrumah-Elie et al., 2026](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.medrxiv.org%2Fcontent%2F10.64898%2F2026.10.12.26365345v1&esheet=54640156&newsitemid=20261112603360&lan=en-US&anchor=Nkrumah-Elie+et+al.%2C+2026&index=5&md5=6da4431f5074b3e16a0fee9a17d2a890) ;[Russ et al., 2026](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.medrxiv.org%2Fcontent%2F10.64898%2F2026.10.13.26365470v1&esheet=54640156&newsitemid=20261112603360&lan=en-US&anchor=Russ+et+al.%2C+2026&index=6&md5=64138a6e824590d88c249250c66c66b8) ).


The Niagen Plus telehealth platform remains clinician-directed. Patients complete an online intake form, a licensed provider decides whether to prescribe, and if prescribed, the medication is dispensed from state-licensed 503A compounding pharmacies and shipped to their door. NiagenPlus.com is LegitScript Certified, an independent third-party certification for healthcare merchants and telehealth platforms.


**The process is simple**


1. Find and click the Truemed logo during checkout.
2. The Niagen Plus program is already eligible through Truemed, so the customer will go straight to the Truemed payment screen.
3. After payment, the customer will return to Niagen Plus to complete their medical questionnaire. A licensed clinician will review their information, and if a prescription is not right for them, their purchase will be fully refunded.


To learn more and shop the Niagen At-Home Injection Kit now available for $199 with HSA/FSA funds, visit[www.niagenplus.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenplus.com%2Fpages%2Fhsa-fsa&esheet=54640156&newsitemid=20261112603360&lan=en-US&anchor=www.niagenplus.com&index=7&md5=955bdd8ac7b8d1a3c04433ba82d17c94) and look for “Shop with HSA/FSA.” Truemed is for qualified customers. HSA/FSA tax savings vary. Learn more at truemed.com/disclosures.


For additional information on Niagen Plus, visit[www.niagenplus.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenplus.com&esheet=54640156&newsitemid=20261112603360&lan=en-US&anchor=www.niagenplus.com&index=8&md5=3bb95532a6229f5f84026bb5375e3db5) .


**About Niagen Bioscience**


[Niagen Bioscience, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenbioscience.com%2F&esheet=54640156&newsitemid=20261112603360&lan=en-US&anchor=Niagen+Bioscience%2C+Inc.&index=9&md5=a019e49bdb25866aa4ab89c5d113c82a) (NASDAQ: NAGE) is the global authority in healthy aging and NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) science. As a trusted pioneer of NAD+ discoveries, Niagen Bioscience™ is dedicated to advancing healthspan through precision science and innovative NAD+-boosting solutions.


The Niagen Bioscience team, composed of world-renowned scientists, works with independent investigators from esteemed universities and research institutions around the globe to uncover the full potential of NAD+. A vital coenzyme found in every cell of the human body, NAD+ declines with age and exposure to everyday lifestyle stressors. NAD+ depletion is a key contributor to age-related changes in health and vitality.


Distinguished by state-of-the-art laboratories, rigorous scientific and quality protocols, and collaborations with leading research institutions worldwide, Niagen Bioscience sets the gold standard for research, quality, and innovation. There’s a better way to age.


At the heart of its clinically tested product portfolio is Niagen® (patented nicotinamide riboside, or NR), the most efficient, well-researched, and high-quality NAD+ booster available. Niagen powers the Company’s consumer supplement, Tru Niagen®, the number one NAD+ boosting oral supplement in the United States† (available at[www.truniagen.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.truniagen.com&esheet=54640156&newsitemid=20261112603360&lan=en-US&anchor=www.truniagen.com&index=10&md5=ce3c3db7733c1e672fea79525404f04e) ), and Niagen™ Plus, featuring pharmaceutical-grade intravenous (IV) and injectable Niagen products ([www.niagenplus.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenplus.com&esheet=54640156&newsitemid=20261112603360&lan=en-US&anchor=www.niagenplus.com&index=11&md5=ca4b8a70a735a7f9f9a37c8922a77670) ). Pharmaceutical-grade Niagen IV and injections are compounded and distributed by U.S. FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facilities and are available exclusively at clinics with a prescription. NAD Pharmaceuticals Corp., the Company’s wholly owned subsidiary focused on developing therapies for accelerated aging and rare genetic diseases, is conducting research on NB4168, a differentiated small molecule.


Niagen Bioscience’s robust patent portfolio protects NR and other NAD+ precursors. Niagen Bioscience maintains a website at[www.niagenbioscience.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenbioscience.com&esheet=54640156&newsitemid=20261112603360&lan=en-US&anchor=www.niagenbioscience.com&index=12&md5=31259910451957f3c4e1b230d236256b) , where copies of press releases, news, and financial information are regularly published.
